description: Center-canvas 'suggested destinations' cards for the Round 2 agent workspace (TDD-v2.1 SS VIII/XI). Content is not new copy — it is assembled from data/routes/*.json (tripArchetypes, seasonalityNotes, licensed hero image) and data/experiences/*.json (highlight teasers), so nothing here is a fresh, unsourced marketing claim.
note: Ranking by traveller vibe (tripArchetypes overlap) rather than a per-origin commercial push - no real VNA directive on which gateway to promote per Australian city exists in this dataset, so origin is not used to bias the order.

destinations.subtitle: Beach & relaxation, central coast

image.licenseNote: CC BY 2.0 — attribution required. Credit ". Ray in Manila / Wikimedia Commons / CC BY 2.0" wherever the image is displayed. Downloaded 2026-09-12 from Wikimedia Commons at 1920px.

destinations.seasonalityNotes: Central Vietnam is driest and sunniest from February to August; September to December is the wet season, with October and November carrying the highest rain and storm risk.
destinations.sourceDocument: Connection: Lotusmiles sector table lists no Australia-to-Da Nang sector; vietnamairlines.com/en-au/flights-from-melbourne-to-da-nang states nonstop flights are not available and VNA operates connecting options via Hanoi or Ho Chi Minh City. Routed via SGN. Duration: vietnamairlines.com/en-au route page, published: 12 hours 30 minutes – 33 hours 55 minutes including transit (low end used). Fare band: Relative fare band: tercile of a nine-route AUD snapshot captured 2026-09-12 from the vietnamairlines.com/en-au route pages (site notes fares are collected within 48hrs and may change). Not a live price. Miles: Lotusmiles published sector distances — vietnamairlines.com/au/en/lotusmiles/earn-miles/earn-miles-after-flights/eligible-flight-and-miles-scheme. Promotion: vietnamairlines.com/au/en/plan-book/LotuSociety/lotustudents-offers. Captured 2026-09-12.
